data.long_description:
Apartment for Rent in Dubai Creek Harbour

Provident Real Estate proudly presents this spacious and bright 2-bedroom corner apartment in Creek Palace. Located on a high floor with stunning lagoon views, this elegant residence offers luxury waterfront living in one of Dubai’s most sought-after communities.

Multiple units available for rent and sale.

Property Features:
- Spacious 2 Bedrooms
- 2 Modern Bathrooms
- High Floor
- Corner Unit
- Large Balcony
- Beautiful Lagoon View
- Bright Open-Plan Living & Dining Area
- Floor-to-Ceiling Windows
- Contemporary Finishes
- Covered Parking

Amenities:
- Infinity Swimming Pool
- Fully Equipped Gym
- Valet Parking
- 24/7 Concierge Service
- Children’s Play Area
- Retail Shops & Cafés
- Restaurants
- Luxury Lobby
- High-Speed Elevators
- 24/7 Security & CCTV

Prime Location:
- 10 Minutes to Downtown Dubai
- 10 Minutes to Dubai Mall & Burj Khalifa
- 10 Minutes to Dubai International Airport
- Easy Access to Major Roads
- Close to Creek Beach & Marina

 Community Highlights:
Creek Palace at Dubai Creek Harbour offers a premium waterfront lifestyle with modern architecture, luxury amenities, and breathtaking surroundings. Developed by Emaar Properties, the community is known for its vibrant atmosphere, scenic waterfront promenade, and world-class living experience.

Perfect for families and professionals looking for a luxury apartment in Dubai Creek Harbour with lagoon views and excellent connectivity.

For more information or to arrange a viewing, contact the area specialist today.
